the mechanisms underlying the dual regulatory role of TRIP8b and cAMP on HCN channels.
the molecular mechanisms of the cAMP-mediated regulation of HCN channels, a fundamental mechanism in the control of sleep, cognition, and memory in the brain.

the molecular mechanisms of cAMP regulation of the HCN current, which is critical because it is involved in higher order brain functions, such sleep, memory, cognition, and epilepsy, and in several neurological diseases, such as Parkinson’s and Alzheimer’s diseases.
